purpose: Curated catalog of code/security AUDIT tools that RUN headless and emit a machine-parseable result (JSON / score / fail exit) — so WALTEUR can wrap them as EXECUTING gates (run + observe + fail-closed), the pattern that closes the PROOF gap. Web-verified 2026-06-28. Tools that only produce LLM judgment (no deterministic executable result) are reference-only — they cannot be executing gates.

tools.name: Knip
tools.machine_output: JSON {issues:[...]} per-file (files/dependencies/exports/unlisted/...) + fail-closed exit (0 clean, 1 findings, 2 error)
tools.gate: dead-code-gate (EXECUTING): run, parse issues, exit==2->FAIL(tool error), exit==1->FAIL(or jq threshold), exit==0->PASS
tools.overlaps: complements maintainability/anti-slop (replaces a shape-read 'no dead code' claim with an EXECUTED module-graph verdict); unlisted/phantom deps complement SBOM
tools.governance: ISC permissive, fully offline (no network/telemetry/PII), JS/TS only. Pin the version (fast-moving) + lockfile-backed acquisition.

tools.name: orm-doctor (NoctisNova)
tools.category: static ORM/DB health (TS/Prisma/Drizzle): N+1, missing indexes, unsafe raw SQL, mass mutations, unbounded queries, missing transactions
tools.machine_output: JSON {score:0-100, issueCount, issues[]{severity,penalty,file}} on STDOUT + exit 1 on any critical (e.g. $queryRawUnsafe, updateMany/deleteMany without WHERE)
tools.gate: db-health-gate (EXECUTING): parse STDOUT (not the interactive file), fail if exit!=0 OR .score<threshold OR any severity==critical
tools.overlaps: AST-grade upgrade to data-correctness-gate (which is static-regex); critical raw-SQL/table-wipe overlaps security-gate
tools.governance: MIT, offline in --json mode (verified zero network; --json exits before the interactive claude -p hand-off). BRAND NEW (0 stars, solo maintainer) -> PIN exact version + vendor the tarball + fail on parser error.

tools.name: MEDUSA (Pantheon-Security)
tools.category: AI security scanner: 40k+ patterns (Log4Shell/Spring4Shell/LangChain RCE/MCP tool poisoning/prompt injection), secrets scan
tools.machine_output: machine-parseable scan output + fail exit on findings (verify --json flag at pin time)
tools.gate: security-scan-gate (EXECUTING): run scan, fail on findings over severity threshold
tools.overlaps: complements security-gate/agent-security/osv/cve; strongest on AI/agent/MCP supply-chain + secrets
tools.governance: AGPL-3.0 — COPYLEFT: running it as a CI tool/CLI does NOT taint WALTEUR's code (mere aggregation/use), but DO NOT vendor/modify its source into the product. Network only if scanning a remote --git URL; secrets-scan is local. Treat as the 'before calling it finished' security pass.

tools.name: Ponytail
tools.category: AI code reviewer (maintainability/readability/architecture) — LLM judgment, works with 16 agents
tools.machine_output: none deterministic — it is an LLM reviewer (PROTOCOL judgment, not an executable pass/fail)
tools.gate: NOT an executing gate — it is a reviewer. Overlaps WALTEUR's existing reviewer panel + anti-slop/maintainability gates.
tools.overlaps: code-review / anti-slop-code / maintainability-gate / the senior reviewer persona
tools.governance: MIT clean. But it cannot close the PROOF gap (no deterministic result). Reference-only: optionally add as a reviewer in the persona panel; do not gate on it.

tools.name: ReconForge
tools.category: AI-assisted recon (subdomain discovery via crt.sh, port scan, tech detection, scope checking) — bug-bounty/runtime
tools.cli: (python recon CLI against a DEPLOYED target)
tools.machine_output: markdown reports + findings (targets a live external attack surface, not source)
tools.gate: NOT a build-time gate — runtime/post-deploy recon. Relevant only ONCE a product is actually deployed (the field-ship); pairs with dast/security-baseline against the live URL.
tools.governance: MIT. Recon against third-party infra has authorization/legal constraints (only scan owned/authorized targets). Reference-only until there is a deployed product to point it at.
